app.title: G'mic 4.0: Squaring the Pixel, Easier
app.author: dtschump
app.description: G'mic is an image processing and manipulation tool.
proposed_tests: Install gmic CLI and run a basic command
Use gmic to convert an image to grayscale
Measure performance of gmic vs ImageMagick
